rationale: Continuing proven mixed fermentation of glucose and lactate with ammonium as nitrogen source. Produces acetate, propionate, butyrate, and CO2 as typical saccharolytic fermentation products. Carbon-limited growth at 0.19/h given 57 mmol C input minus 49.1 mmol C output leaves 7.9 mmol C for biomass (41 mmol C/gDW requirement).
